classification.difficultyReason: Interpret different axis scales and choose readable points to calculate gradients. The decimal-scale graph additionally requires deriving an intercept between grid levels from the gradient and a known point.

content.prompt: Determine the equation of these lines.

spec.description: Three-column question graph; horizontal grid step 5 and vertical grid step 100. Preserve labelled ticks, both axis titles and line arrowheads.
spec.mathematics: y=13x+40; x grid range -15 to 25; y grid range -200 to 400.
spec.answerVisibility: The function equation is not printed on the student graph.

spec.description: Horizontal grid step 10; vertical grid step 40; labelled zero on the x-axis.
spec.mathematics: y=2x+40; x grid range -20 to 70; y grid range 0 to 200.
spec.answerVisibility: No equation or answer annotations on the student graph.

spec.description: Horizontal grid step 2 and vertical grid step 15; intercepts at (0,60) and (10,0).
spec.answerVisibility: The student graph contains the supplied line only.

spec.description: Decimal vertical scale: grid step 0.05, labelled 0.1 and 0.2. Horizontal grid step 5.
spec.answerVisibility: No supplied equation in the student diagram.

spec.description: First-quadrant graph with no x or y title. Grid steps 10 horizontally and 4 vertically; zero labelled on the vertical axis.
spec.mathematics: y=7x/25; line begins at the origin and passes through (50,14).
spec.answerVisibility: Equation withheld from the student graph.

answer.worked:
The line passes through the origin, so $c=0$. Using $(0,0)$ and $(50,14)$:
$$\begin{align*}m&=\frac{14}{50}\\m&=\frac{7}{25}\\y&=\frac{7x}{25}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: First-quadrant graph without axis titles. Horizontal grid step 500 with labels at 1000, 2000 and 3000; vertical step 200.
spec.mathematics: y=6x/25; passes through the origin and (2500,600).
spec.answerVisibility: No equation printed on the student graph.

answer.worked:
The line passes through the origin, so $c=0$. Using $(0,0)$ and $(2500,600)$:
